secondary.name: C1q complement recognition complex
secondary.rationale: C1q is the recognition component of the classical complement pathway. C1r/C1s and C3 define two specified biological comparisons. Measure regional protein abundance and paired coverage for these exact lists.
secondary.selection: Lists fixed during software development before inspecting their effect estimates. Prior exploratory access to these datasets is disclosed. This application is exploratory.
secondary.interpretation: Regional normalized protein abundance. Complement activation, molecular assembly and cell of origin require additional evidence. Cross-study donor independence is unresolved.
